project.title: Bacterial communities in activated sludge under antibiotic stress
project.description: This study aims to investigate the variation patterns of activated sludge microbial communities under high antibiotic stress, elucidate how they adapt to antibiotic pressure through network interactions, life-history strategy adjustments, and community assembly processes, and provide microbial ecological insights for the operation of antibiotic wastewater treatment systems.
